newsitem.title: USA: Amrion ends strategic talks with company.
newsitem.headline: Amrion ends strategic talks with company.

text.p: Amrion Inc said Friday it had broken off talks a "possible strategic business combination" with a company in the same industry because the proposed terms did not suit the interests of its shareholders.

"(Amrion) concluded that the proposed terms and conditions would not serve the best interests of its shareholders," said the company, which makes and markets nutriceuticals and nutritional supplements.
It did not identify the company with which it had been talking.
Its stock resumed trading on the NASDAQ National Market at 1:35 p.m. local after being halted earlier in the day.
Robin Kelley, who is in charge of investor relations for the company, said Amrion had been looking to form a partnership or conduct a merger.
Kelley said the company had begun talks with "a few" companies in October before narrowing it down to one.
She declined to give any further details.
